main_text.p: platione, [?]ed pro præmissis & pro suis ditando pa-rentibus, ac pro nido suo, quia Aquilam exaltans doper præmissa & alia imposita per eundem, to-talem pecuniam Anglicanam nouï domini genere iam compellit, ne dissimulata in hac parte simplici tas regni huius subuersionem auferat, uelut tuam, & adhibeatur seró remedij tunc cautela. Auertat hempe Dominus uirtutum de corde uiri illius ue-lamen, fibiq; cor contritum & humile largiatur: & agnoscere cum faciat uestigia ueri Dei, per quæ à suis tenebris eruatur, & præmissos labores si-nistros dimittere compellatur: nec non & uineam quam plantauit Dei dextra, sacræ fidei cultoribus repleatur. Animaduerte enim uerba Domini, & prophetiam Ieremiæ, ad propulsandum huiusmo-di incboata, quæ dicunt: Tu pastor, qui populum meum differfisti, & cum de suis habitationibus e-iectisti, ecce uisitabo super te tuorum maliciam slu-diorum, nec erit uir qui super solium Dauid de tuo semine sedeat, nec qui in luda ultrà habeat potestà tem, fiat nidus tuus defertus, & ficut Sodoma & Gomorra, taliter fit subuersus: qui si perterritus ex his dictis non desiterit ab inceptis, & restitu-tionem non ferent de perceptis, psal'ent pro eo extunc nequiter corde indurato psalmum centesi-mumoctauū, illi cui omnia seruiunt, aperte singulí [?]

page.notes: Scan is blurred, especially in the lower half and at line ends. Many words are doubtful and are marked [?] or should be checked against the original. The left margin shows show-through from the other side and was left out. The opening word "platione" is a fragment continuing from the previous page. Long s is written as plain s throughout. The "=" at line ends is a printed hyphen and is written as "-". The text contains no marginal notes.
